B.plano: Next turn expect to capture Huesca, raising our held villages to 7. Use newly built spearmen to reinforce front lines and prepare further assaults on Teruel or Madrid. Keep watch for enemy forces emerging from the west. Do not split attacks; concentrate strength for each target.
